      <bpmn:documentation>Time collected by fitness gadget.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Run_Join" name="5 km run and time measured">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" name="Under 25 minutes?" default="Flow_NotGood">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Good</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotGood</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotGood</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retrain</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Good</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareTime" name="Compare starting time with end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Split" name="More than 1 hour left?" default="Flow_LeaveWork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoHome" name="Go to Night Run from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Join" name="Arrive at Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" name="Run and drink">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Run" name="Run the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Drink" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrink_Join" name="Run and drink finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:documentation>Collected by fitness gadget.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalTime" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectBlock" targetRef="Gateway_Attempt_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Attempt_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Run_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Run_Split" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Run_Split" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Gateway_Run_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_Run_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Run_Join" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Good" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_GetNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${runTimeMinutes < 25}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotGood" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retrain" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Gateway_Attempt_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_GetNumber" targetRef="Task_CompareTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CompareTime" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_GoHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hoursLeftBetweenStartAndWorkEnd > 1}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_LeaveWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_GoHome" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWork" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Join" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" targetRef="Task_Run"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Run" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTime" targetRef="End_FinalTime"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
